key_insight: DynamicVLA enables reliable manipulation of moving objects by combining a compact vision-language-action backbone with explicit temporal reasoning and closed-loop adaptation, allowing fast perception-to-action loops for dynamic scenarios.
problem_solved: Bridges the gap between strong static-scene VLA capabilities and real-world dynamic object manipulation that requires rapid temporal anticipation and continuous control.
method: Compact 0.4B VLA backbone with a convolutional vision encoder for spatially efficient perception and low-latency inference.
Temporal reasoning module that predicts short-horizon object motion and integrates past observations for anticipation.
Closed-loop adaptation and continuous control pipeline that updates actions in real time based on streamed visual and language inputs.
impact: Makes dynamic-object manipulation practical for resource-constrained robots and interactive agents by enabling anticipatory, closed-loop control with a small, deployable VLA model—reducing latency and improving robustness in time-sensitive tasks.
visual_elements: Pipeline diagram: camera + language input → conv vision encoder → temporal predictor → closed-loop controller → robot actuator
Timeline / anticipation graphic: past frames → predicted future trajectory → action update points
Performance bar/line chart: accuracy or success rate on static vs dynamic tasks and latency comparison for small vs large models
Icon set: compact model chip, real-time loop arrow, moving object (ball) to symbolize dynamics, and language balloon
paper_title: DynamicVLA: A Vision-Language-Action Model for Dynamic Object Manipulation
paper_authors: Haozhe Xie, Beichen Wen, Jiarui Zheng, Zhaoxi Chen, Fangzhou Hong
